theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
